## Install

**Chrome:** download `hookr-chrome.zip` and unzip it somewhere you'll keep it. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the folder. To update, unzip the new version over the old folder and click **Reload** on Hookr's card.

**Firefox:** Firefox only keeps signed add-ons, so until Hookr is on Firefox Add-ons this one lasts until you restart Firefox. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`, click **Load Temporary Add-on** and pick `hookr-firefox.zip`. Firefox 142 or newer.

Then click the Hookr button on a post you wrote.
